subject.title: Feature Request: Add 'description' field to agent config for dynamic agent discovery

question: Should `agents_list` expose optional operator-authored agent descriptions as a supported discovery contract for orchestration?
rationale: Current main supports the metadata but not its runtime discovery use; choosing whether and how broadly it becomes model-facing tool output is a durable product/API decision.

options.title: Approve bounded discovery metadata
options.body: Define a modest description contract and land the focused open PR after rebase and current-head validation.

options.title: Keep descriptions configuration-only
options.body: Retain current storage and Doctor preservation behavior but decline exposing descriptions through `agents_list`.

options.title: Choose another discovery surface
options.body: Track a narrower design for system-prompt or registry-based discovery instead of expanding the existing tool contract.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded discovery metadata
recommendation.body: Define a modest description contract and land the focused open PR after rebase and current-head validation.

likelyOwner.reason: History connects this person most directly to the existing agent-list and multi-agent routing behavior.
